common_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one full-body 2D tactical-game character on genuine transparent background. Reinterpret the specified hero from user-party.png in the clean hand-drawn cartoon style of Kingdom Rush. Use kr-gerald.png and kr-hero2.png as visual style references only: bold dark brown outlines, expressive oversized head, sturdy hands and boots, broad color areas, two or three flat cel-shaded values per material, crisp smooth edges. Retain the user's hero identity, clothing colors, equipment and compact approximately three-heads-tall proportions. Elevated front three-quarter camera, facing screen-right with face visible, both feet visible; relaxed ready-to-fight idle stance. One centered character, whole figure and all equipment fully inside frame, about 80% canvas height with generous clear margin. Same camera, scale and line weight across the four-character set. No text, labels, logos, badges, circles, borders, ground, tile, platform, cast shadow, scenery or other figures. No pixel blocks, dithering, grain, photorealism or 3D-rendered material. Keep silhouette readable when shown at 128 pixels tall. Deliver one isolated transparent PNG.
